n: David W. Patten, a senior member of the Twelve, is told to wrap up his business and sell his goods so he can go on a mission with the whole quorum the following spring. Sadly, he was killed in the Battle of Crooked River in October 1838, becoming an early apostle-martyr.

f.g: Ordained an apostle in 1835; he died October 25, 1838, after being wounded at Crooked River, Missouri.

f.w: make a disposition of his merchandise
f.g: Sell off or otherwise dispose of his stock of goods.

n: Some leaders were denying the Lord in 1838; their positions would be given to others. “Bishopric” here means office or calling in general, not a bishop’s office specifically.

f.w: others shall be planted in their stead

f.g: An office or position of responsibility (as in Acts 1:20, KJV).
